summary: Fun way to solve puzzles: find missing parts and match them to complete images!
description:
Dive into the world of "Art Story Puzzle," a unique game that mixes art with brain-teasing challenges. As you follow the story, you'll unravel mysteries by solving puzzles hidden within beautiful artworks. Sharpen your mind, get creative, and uncover the secrets behind each masterpiece.

In Art Story Puzzle, your goal is to solve puzzles cleverly hidden within stunning artworks. These puzzles come in various forms, from tricky riddles to interactive jigsaw challenges. Each puzzle is designed to test your thinking skills and imagination. As you progress, you'll uncover more of the intriguing story.

Features:

Tease Your Brain:
Challenge yourself with mind-bending puzzles that require logic, creativity, and problem-solving. These puzzles are fun exercises that make your brain sharper while having a good time

Uncover the Story Teller:
Can you figure out who's behind the mysterious artworks? Each puzzle solved brings you closer to discovering the storyteller's identity. The story twists and turns to keep you engaged in the journey.

Hidden Pieces and Moves:
Piece together hidden jigsaw fragments of the artworks. Use the displace feature to move elements and find hidden hints. This adds an exciting twist to traditional jigsaw puzzles.

Art Story Puzzle is not just a game, it's an adventure that combines puzzles, art, and storytelling. Whether you love puzzles, art or just want a new challenge, this game offers a fun experience. Can you solve the riddles, and uncover the Art Story Puzzle's secrets? Embark on this journey today!
